__NOTOC__
<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="amascut-the-devourer" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Amascut, the Devourer</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/EFlnaJbrvr.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The aim of this guide is to provide a basic overview of how to get consistent kills at Amascut, the Devourer. Due to the boss' high defence levels, demanding DPS checks and mechanical complexity, contents of this guide assume you have at least made it to the end of Stage 1 of </nowiki><span><nowiki>#upgrade-order</nowiki></span><nowiki> for your chosen style. As Amascut is enrage-based with fixed enrages of 100, 500, 750, 1000, 2000 and 4000%, mechanics and strategies may differ based on enrage. For the purposes of this guide, 100% enrage will be utilized.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="disclaimer"><nowiki>Disclaimer</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This guide, and its contents thereof, assume you are getting started with Amascut, and does not necessarily cover meta strategies.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="general-information"><ins><nowiki>General Information</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut, the Devourer is located in Menaphos. Fighting her requires completion of the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Eclipse of the Heart</nowiki></strong><nowiki> quest.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ She has variable LP based on chosen mode and enrage:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Normal Mode</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>: 4.0M</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>100%</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>: 5.5M</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>500%</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>: 7M</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>750%</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>: 8M</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>1000%</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>: 9M</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>2000%</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>: 12M</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>4000%</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>: 16M</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Defensively, Amascut has a Defence </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689509250979987525.png?v=1" alt="defence" title="defence" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level of 95, with 2765 Armour and an affinity of 55 Affinity against all styles.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut is immune to stuns </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289428492369.png?v=1" alt="stunicon" title="stunicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and poison </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/944649693500154006.png?v=1" alt="poisonicon" title="poisonicon" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Her minions can be poisoned and stunned.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut is mechanically complex, consisting of 5 phases in Normal and 7 phases in Enrage mode.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="gear-relics-familiars"><ins><nowiki>Gear, Relics, Familiars</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The following presets are based on Stage 1 and provided by Amascut, the Devourer Discord:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=c9915f48-ad2f-4a74-bc28-de538d40826e <nowiki>Necromancy</nowiki>]<pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/cba8d6dd68abecd4861b4e0eed8cbb75ccdc217835961584c9d68464ed4c4352.webp" alt="Amascut Basic - Necromancy" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=nfm2UnsVqmKfaFDf2Z9X <nowiki>Magic</nowiki>]<nowiki>
</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://firebasestorage.googleapis.com/v0/b/preset-images/o/images%2Fnfm2UnsVqmKfaFDf2Z9X.png?alt=media" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="fight-mechanics-phases-1-3"><ins><nowiki>Fight Mechanics</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (Phases 1 &amp; 3)</nowiki></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut attacks with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, with a mechanic every 3 auto attacks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Magic attacks deal damage to all players, and is telegraphed by Amascut raising her left hand and shooting out a green ball of energy</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Melee attacks deal damage to whoever has Amascut's aggression, and any player within 2-3 tiles near them; telegraphed by Amascut raising her right hand and slashing her target</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Melee attacks will additionally cause </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> arrows to fly at anyone within 10 tiles of her target once the melee hit lands</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Every 4 auto attacks, Amascut will perform </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Rapid Swipes</nowiki></ins><nowiki> where she starts viciously swiping at her target, dealing 2 quick hits of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage based on her last used style, followed by a double hit that inflicts both types of damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In higher enrages, this has massive KO potential</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="attack-rotation"><ins><nowiki>Attack Rotation</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This rotation assumes Amascut is not phased by reaching her hitcap</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ 3 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> auto attacks → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Tri-colour Attack</nowiki></em><nowiki> → Rapid swipes + 2 auto attacks → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Summon Scarabs</nowiki></em><nowiki> → 1 auto attack + Rapid swipes + 1 auto attack → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Soul Crush</nowiki></em><nowiki> → 2 auto attacks + Rapid swipes → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Triple Strike</nowiki></em><nowiki> → 3 auto attacks → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Tri-colour Attack</nowiki></em><nowiki> → Rapid swipes + 2 auto attacks → </nowiki><em><nowiki>Hard phase</nowiki></em><nowiki> (Amascut enters P2 or P4 depending on which phase the players were on)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If the players reach phase hitcap for P1 and/or P3, Amascut will reset her mechanics rotation (starting over with Tri-colour attack being her first mechanic), but will </nowiki><ins><nowiki>not</nowiki></ins><nowiki> reset her auto attack rotation (if she entered P2 after landing Rapid swipes, her P3 rotation will start with 3 regular auto attacks)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="corruption"><ins><nowiki>Corruption</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402610315480535050.png?v=1" alt="corruption" title="corruption" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Persistent mechanic that increases all incoming damage by 10% per stack</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Capped at 15 stacks for a total of 150% damage increase</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Sources:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut's auto-attacks against her </nowiki><ins><nowiki>main target</nowiki></ins><nowiki> each inflict a stack</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Getting hit by Devourer's Shockwaves or Soulfire Waves inflict a stack</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="tri-colour-attack"><ins><nowiki>Tri-colour Attack</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut will flash 3 orbs in order, </nowiki><ins><nowiki>one for each style</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, and attack the Base Tank in the order she flashed the orbs</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The attacks deal heavy damage if not prayed against, and will stun the player taking them at 500% enrage or higher</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut </nowiki><ins><nowiki>telegraphs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> which styles she will attack with when she performs the mechanic:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence pvme-source-prayer"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>Pathetic</nowiki></code><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence pvme-source-prayer"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>Weak</nowiki></code><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence pvme-source-prayer"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>Grovel</nowiki></code><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306475151390.png?v=1" alt="anti" title="anti" kind="icon" /><nowiki> protects against being stunned at 500% enrage or higher</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Only affects the Base Tank, other roles are safe</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/ZO7c5iux5L.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="summon-scarabs"><ins><nowiki>Summon Scarabs</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut summons 2-5 scarabs per player based on enrage, charging up over time</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The scarabs are Immune to damage until they are stunned</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Once fully charged, they explode, dealing soft typeless damage to all players in the arena</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Their damage can be mitigated entirely by casting </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If unavailable, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used as a last resort</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stepping on them as they spawn will prevent them from spawning entirely, doing so will reset the cooldown of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stunning them will lift their damage immunity and kill them due to their low health (2000 LP)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="soul-crush-aka-bend-the-knee"><ins><nowiki>Soul Crush</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (a.k.a. Bend the Knee)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut deals massive soft typeless damage to her main target, split between all players in a 3x3 radius of her target</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Has 50% piercing against defensive abilities</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Base Tank can </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1" alt="immort" title="immort" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at the end of </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>Tri-colour Attack</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> at earliest to negate this mechanic, assuming they do not proc it earlier</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ DPS pile can </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Soul Crush and split it between themselves, using </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to stay alive</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/DTnk2wbbf4.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="triple-strike"><ins><nowiki>Triple Strike</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut alters the skybox colour and prepares to launch 3 devastating hits with the same style she calls out</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Not praying against the hits correctly deals massive damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Affects all players in the encounter</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut </nowiki><ins><nowiki>telegraphs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> which style she will attack with when she performs the mechanic:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-prayer"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>All strength withers</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎(skybox turns </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>red</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>): 3 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hits</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-prayer"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>I will not suffer this</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎(skybox turns </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>green</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>): 3 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hits</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-prayer"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><code><nowiki>Your soul is WEAK</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎(skybox turns </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>blue</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>): 3 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> hits</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will fully protect you from all 3 hits, as long as you are praying against the style correctly</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If timed correctly, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can gain a massive amount of healing and adren respectively from the third hit</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/SH08p0rCVi.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="fight-mechanics-phases-2-4"><ins><nowiki>Fight Mechanics</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (Phases 2 &amp; 4)</nowiki></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut stops attacking, becomes Immune to all damage, and charges a wipe mechanic</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ She will invoke the names of two of the Bau of Tumeken (Apmeken and Crondis in Phase 2, Scabaras and Het in Phase 4), causing their respective mechanics to become active</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Failure to complete this phase in less than 200 seconds will result in a </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>WIPE</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1" alt="instakill" title="instakill" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This timer is reduced to 125 seconds at 1000% enrage, and further reduced to 100 seconds at 2000%</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="statues-fragments"><ins><nowiki>Statues &amp; Fragments</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The statues of the Bau of Tumeken are </nowiki><ins><nowiki>corrupted</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, and must be </nowiki><ins><nowiki>cleansed</nowiki></ins><nowiki> and </nowiki><ins><nowiki>restored</nowiki></ins><nowiki> to progress the fight</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Clicking on the statue while they are glowing </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>green</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> will deal hard typeless damage to all players in the encounter</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The statues can be </nowiki><ins><nowiki>cleansed</nowiki></ins><nowiki> by clicking on them once they start glowing </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>golden</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> (indicating a </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Chain</nowiki></ins><nowiki> inside was brought to 0 HP), doing so three times will cleanse the statue, allowing it to be restored</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The statues can be </nowiki><ins><nowiki>restored</nowiki></ins><nowiki> by bringing its respective Fragment of Tumeken to them, this will stagger Amascut, interrupting her channelling and removing her damage immunity, allowing the encounter to be progressed</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once both statues for that phase are </nowiki><ins><nowiki>restored</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, the phase ends when Amascut is damaged to her hitcap, or once she fully recovers</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="portals-inside-rooms"><ins><nowiki>Portals</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (Inside Rooms)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In order to cleanse the statues, players must enter through a portal on each side of the arena, guarded by a </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Gatekeeper gorilla akh</nowiki></ins></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Gatekeeper gorilla akh</nowiki></ins><nowiki> has crawling speed, can potentially stun players with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> attacks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once inside, the players must work together and towards killing the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Chainwarden mage akh</nowiki></ins><nowiki> and the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>chains</nowiki></ins><nowiki> preventing the players from claiming a </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Fragment of Tumeken</nowiki></ins></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The chains, once they drop to </nowiki><strong><nowiki>0 LP</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, must be </nowiki><ins><nowiki>cleansed</nowiki></ins><nowiki> to fully destroy them, and once all three are destroyed, the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Fragment of Tumeken</nowiki></ins><nowiki> can be claimed to restore its respective statue</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Gatekeeper gorilla akh</nowiki></ins><nowiki> can be dispatched relatively easily with high burst damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Inside (Chains) and Outside (Statues) players must work together to take out the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Chainwarden</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, Chains player takes out </nowiki><strong><nowiki>two</nowiki></strong><nowiki> chains and carries the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Fragment of Tumeken</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, while the Statues player takes out </nowiki><strong><nowiki>one</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and cleanses their side's statue</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In Phase 4, both players remain inside as the Base Tank can singlehandedly cleanse both statues due to their proximity</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Chains player runs the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Fragment of Tumeken</nowiki></ins><nowiki> across the arena, the correct statue to </nowiki><ins><nowiki>restore</nowiki></ins><nowiki> is on the </nowiki><strong><nowiki>opposite</nowiki></strong><nowiki> side of where they entered through the portal (e.g. East player must ferry the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>fragments</nowiki></ins><nowiki> to the Western statues)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• While carrying the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Fragment of Tumeken</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258832052231.png?v=1" alt="escape" title="escape" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &amp; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are disabled, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532853916860437.png?v=1" alt="barge" title="barge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can still be utilised</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note:</nowiki></em><nowiki> </nowiki><em><nowiki>Gatekeeper gorilla akhs have a chance to stun you with their melee attacks starting at 1000% enrage</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="apmekens-burden"><ins><nowiki>Apmeken's Burden</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402579857648390224.png?v=1" alt="apmekensburden" title="apmekensburden" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Shortly after Phase 2 starts, Amascut marks one random player who is outside with </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Apmeken's Burden</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, a hard hitting bleed that deals typeless damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The bleed wears off after a while, length based on enrage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Apmeken's Burden</nowiki></ins><nowiki> deals damage to a player for the 8th time (indicated by the number of stacks on the debuff), that player is </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>instakilled</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1" alt="instakill" title="instakill" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Players can pass </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Apmeken's Burden</nowiki></ins><nowiki> around to reset its stacks, to pass the debuff the player must be standing in a 1 tile radius of the player who </nowiki><strong><nowiki>never</nowiki></strong><nowiki> got the burden during the phase when its damage ticks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Should the debuff be applied, it can be safely ignored in enrages less than 2000% as it will never instakill </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1" alt="instakill" title="instakill" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Apmeken's Burden</nowiki></ins><nowiki> can be skipped </nowiki><strong><nowiki>entirely</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, if Amascut cannot find a target when she tries to mark a player (e.g. all players are inside the portal) the debuff will never be applied</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="modest-crocodile-demons"><ins><nowiki>Modest Crocodile Demons</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402583151322071091.png?v=1" alt="modesty" title="modesty" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At the start of Phase 2, and again once a player starts running the Fragment of Tumeken from Crondis, two </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Modest crocodile demons</nowiki></ins><nowiki> will spawn, one for each side of the arena</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Modest crocodile demons primarily attack with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, sometimes attacking with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if their target is too close</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Once the adrenaline bar above their head is charged, they fire a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> attack that </nowiki><strong><nowiki>cannot miss</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, draining the player's adrenaline by 20% and halving their adrenaline gain for a short time</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ These creatures have the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Modesty</nowiki></ins><nowiki> and </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Provoke Immune</nowiki></ins><nowiki> buffs, reflecting damage from enhanced and ultimate abilities, as well as special attacks while preventing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> from changing their targets</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray against their attacks and use basic abilities and conjures </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1166094935066423348.png?v=1" alt="conjurearmy" title="conjurearmy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to kill them</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Necromancers are strongly recommended to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as it will speed up the kills</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ They will attack the first target they see until they lose them; as they are </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Provoke Immune</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, Statues roles should have their aggro once the second set spawns, Base Tank can tank/dispatch the first set</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="healing-in-strength"><ins><nowiki>Healing in Strength</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585055297273896.png?v=1" alt="healinginstrength" title="healinginstrength" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut will heal for a portion of all damage dealt by her minions (except for the Chainwarden mage akh) during Phase 4</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ This mechanic can be safely ignored as the healing is usually negligible</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If going for </nowiki><strong><nowiki>You Shall Not Heal</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Combat Achievement, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1" alt="ent" title="ent" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1" alt="icebarrage" title="icebarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074306301964.png?v=1" alt="stickybomb" title="stickybomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is strongly recommended to stop </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Feline guard akhs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> and </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Gorilla gatekeeper akhs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> from dealing damage with their attacks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="explosive-scarab-akhs"><ins><nowiki>Explosive Scarab Akhs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585081624924210.png?v=1" alt="carapace" title="carapace" kind="icon" /></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ During Phase 4, Amascut will summon </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Explosive scarab akhs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> with </nowiki><strong><nowiki>5000 LP</nowiki></strong><nowiki> and no damage immunity</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• In addition to the scarabs, Gorilla gatekeeper akhs, Chainwarden mage akhs and Chains all gain damage immunity through the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Carapace</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585081624924210.png?v=1" alt="carapace" title="carapace" kind="icon" /><nowiki> buff</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ On death, the scarabs will start filling a bar above their head, causing them to explode once filled dealing soft typeless damage to all players in the arena</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Any remaining scarabs at the end of Phase 4 will simultaneously die and start charging</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Scarabs can be </nowiki><ins><nowiki>grabbed</nowiki></ins><nowiki> and tossed at targets once they have been killed and start charging their explosion, doing so will lift the Carapace buff from enemies (green glow around them)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• To throw a scarab, click on a dead scarab to grab, then click on a target to throw it</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At the start of Phase 5, use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541306353778689.png?v=1" alt="cade" title="cade" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to null all of their damage as they explode</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/TH3J0tKcHR.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>

</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="floor-mechanics-devourers-shockwaves-soulfire-waves-devourers-hieroglyphs"><ins><nowiki>Floor Mechanics</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (Devourer's Shockwaves, Soulfire Waves, Devourer's Hieroglyphs)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut will blast the ground with high damage </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Shockwaves</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Hieroglyphs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> or </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Soulfire Waves</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, similar to Nakatra in Sanctum of Rebirth</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Shockwaves</nowiki></ins><nowiki> have a fixed pattern and deal typeless damage, disabling defensive abilities and putting them on cooldown for 6s</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Soulfire Waves</nowiki></ins><nowiki> sweep the arena in a set pattern dealing high </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage and lowering the duration of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Hieroglyphs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> split the arena into 9 5x5 tiles, dealing heavy typeless damage and disabling defensive abilities as well as putting them on cooldown for 6s</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Shockwaves appear in Phases 2 (West side), Phase 3, Phase 4 (East side) and Phase 7</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Soulfire Waves appear in Phase 2 and Phase 4</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Hieroglyphs appear in Phase 7 only</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ All floor mechanics are telegraphed, move out of the way if possible</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For Soulfire Waves, praying </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will mitigate some damage, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334377648130.png?v=1" alt="divert" title="divert" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> both block one hit, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can block hits while praying but will suffer duration reduction</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ In Phase 7, dodging </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Shockwaves</nowiki></ins><nowiki> and </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Hieroglyphs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> will </nowiki><ins><nowiki>reset the cooldowns</nowiki></ins><nowiki> of all movement abilities</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="fight-mechanics-phase-5"><ins><nowiki>Fight Mechanics</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (Phase 5)</nowiki></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut will go Immune once again, and summons a pair of soul obelisks that slowly charge towards periodic bursts of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ To progress the fight, the players must work together to charge the Fragments of Tumeken freed in Phases 2 and 4</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ There is no timer in this phase</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="altar-charging"><ins><nowiki>Altar Charging</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Four fragments of Tumeken, two on each side of the arena, will appear directly across the statues</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Far</nowiki></ins><nowiki> fragments are Crondis and Apmeken, and can be charged by the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Solo Charge</nowiki></ins><nowiki> role</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Near</nowiki></ins><nowiki> fragments are Scabaras and Het, and must be charged by the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>South Charge</nowiki></ins><nowiki> and </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Interceptors</nowiki></ins></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ To charge a fragment, the players must form a bridge to carry Tumeken's light shooting out of the statues</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Once at least 1 fragment is charged, players can click on </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Tumeken</nowiki></ins><nowiki> to start reforming him</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Ideally, at least 2 fragments must be charged before clicking on Tumeken to start reformation</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="soul-obelisks"><ins><nowiki>Soul Obelisks</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ A </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Soul obelisk</nowiki></ins><nowiki> will spawn on each side of the arena, slowly charging up its health</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Once fully charged, it will start dealing periodic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to all players in a fairly large AoE</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ So long as the obelisks take damage, they will not charge up</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Using a damage over time ability </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1" alt="bloat" title="bloat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will stop it from charging up without having to actively focus it</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Finishing a charging cycle will also reset the obelisks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="lightstealer-salawa-akhs-aka-dogs"><ins><nowiki>Lightstealer salawa akhs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (a.k.a. Dogs)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ While any number of altars are charging, </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Lightstealer salawa akhs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (dogs) will emerge from the southern stairs, moving towards the charging fragments</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If the dogs make it to their target, they will start to slowly charge up, then sacrifice themselves after fully charging, setting back progression for that fragment by a significant amount</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the fragments have been recalled, they will target Tumeken instead; if they deplete Tumeken's health, it will result in a </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>WIPE</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1" alt="instakill" title="instakill" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Players at the southern side of the arena can use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/567727987274022924.png?v=1" alt="ent" title="ent" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400185245701.png?v=1" alt="icebarrage" title="icebarrage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074306301964.png?v=1" alt="stickybomb" title="stickybomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to stop the dogs from moving</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Attacking will also change their target to the player who dealt damage to them</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ As soon as Tumeken recalls all fragments and starts reforming, they become high priority targets; strong AoE rotations (e.g. </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1" alt="gchain" title="gchain" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1179505745654448208.png?v=1" alt="omnipowerigneous" title="omnipowerigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ) must be utilized to remove them from the arena as quickly as possible</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note:</nowiki></em><nowiki> </nowiki><em><nowiki>Lightstealer salawa akhs will remember their progress to snuff out the light of one of Tumeken's fragments, e.g. if one of them had their charge bar halfway full and switch target over to Tumeken himself, they will continue charging from where they left off, this can lead to unexpected wipes</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="altar-strike"><ins><nowiki>Altar Strike</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ So long as any altars are charging, Amascut will say </nowiki><code><nowiki>Your light will be snuffed out once and for all</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎and launch 1-4 arrows at the altars based on how many altars are charging, dealing heavy damage and reducing a fragment's charge by a significant amount</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Two Interceptor players (Green 1 &amp; Green 2) take turns to stand in front of Amascut, stopping the bolts from flying at the altars; refer to the image below for positioning</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Interrupting Altar Strike deals soft typeless damage that also inflicts the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Interceptor</nowiki></ins><nowiki> debuff, any player with the debuff that gets hit again with Altar Strike is instakilled </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1" alt="instakill" title="instakill" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ The debuff is cleared if another player intercepts the bolts</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Incoming damage should be mitigated with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541278264393729.png?v=1" alt="debil" title="debil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ One good tip is to drop down a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/892342109431029761.png?v=1" alt="prismofsalvation" title="prismofsalvation" kind="icon" /><nowiki> at the North Charge spot for the Interceptors to swap more easily</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/lfr0z98VqG.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="the-god-of-destruction-aka-blinking-strikes"><ins><nowiki>The God of Destruction</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (a.k.a. Blinking strikes)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ As soon as Tumeken starts reforming, Amascut becomes damageable and blinks to a random side of the arena (North, South, West or East), dealing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage and stunning any player in her way</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ During this stage, Amascut will charge four devastating attacks (once per jump) that will deplete Tumeken's reformation progress</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If not intercepted properly or intercepted at all, it will set back Tumeken's reformation progress and deal heavy soft typeless damage to all players as well as stunning them</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Tumeken's life bar depletes, the players </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>WIPE</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1" alt="instakill" title="instakill" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Tumeken</nowiki></ins><nowiki> will call a player to intercept the attack by saying </nowiki><code><nowiki>&lt;playername&gt;, shield us from her shadow...</nowiki></code><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The player who is called out will notice their skybox turn </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>golden</nowiki></strong></ins></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The player called out by Tumeken </nowiki><strong><nowiki>must be the first player</nowiki></strong><nowiki> to be hit by Amascut's attack, intercepting it and preventing potentially lethal damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If they are not the first player to get hit, the attack will deal damage as if it wasn't intercepted at all</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ All players who are standing in a line between Amascut and Tumeken will take typeless damage and have the cooldowns of all mobility abilities reset, allowing easy repositioning</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: Tumeken will </nowiki><ins><nowiki>never</nowiki></ins><nowiki> call the same player to intercept twice in a row</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="fight-mechanics-phase-6"><ins><nowiki>Fight Mechanics</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (Phase 6)</nowiki></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut will summon an </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Engulfing shadow</nowiki></ins><nowiki> that consumes Tumeken, constantly bombarding the arena with projectiles that deal heavy typeless damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ To progress the fight, the players must follow </nowiki><ins><nowiki>the Path of Tumeken</nowiki></ins><nowiki> and take </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Tumeken's light</nowiki></ins></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="the-path-of-tumeken-aka-platforms"><ins><nowiki>The Path of Tumeken</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (a.k.a. Platforms)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The center hieroglyph either on west or east side of the arena will </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>start glowing</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki>, indicating that a player can follow </nowiki><ins><nowiki>the Path of Tumeken</nowiki></ins></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The player following </nowiki><ins><nowiki>the Path of Tumeken</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (climbing) must kill </nowiki><strong><nowiki>four</nowiki></strong><nowiki> mage/range akhs in </nowiki><strong><nowiki>30 seconds</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If the collapse timer runs out, the climber is instakilled </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1" alt="instakill" title="instakill" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, and Amascut will deal however much black health she has as typeless damage to players, split between all players in the arena</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Akhs have only </nowiki><strong><nowiki>15k</nowiki></strong><nowiki> LP, high burst damage will kill them in one or (at worst) two hits</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ While climbing, the climber will see a </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>glowing</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> hieroglyph under the platform they're standing on, if another player stands on the same glyph the climber calls out, the collapse timer will be paused until the next platform</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Once the four akhs are dead, the climber can click on </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Tumeken's light</nowiki></ins><nowiki> to finish climbing and gain the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Enlightened</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1" alt="interceptor" title="interceptor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> buff, for the remainder of the phase they are Amascut's main target</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="climber-rotations"><nowiki>Climber Rotations</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Both rotations assume they start as soon as Amascut calls </nowiki><code><nowiki>I WILL NOT BE DENIED</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎at the start of Phase 6</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Necromancy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></strong><nowiki> (assumes 8 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1" alt="necrosis" title="necrosis" kind="icon" /><nowiki> &amp; 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1" alt="residualsoul" title="residualsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki>): </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434908486357072.png?v=1" alt="livingdeath" title="livingdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809175980810380.png?v=1" alt="touchofdeath" title="touchofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1" alt="residualsoul" title="residualsoul" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (towards the Path of Tumeken) → click the Path of Tumeken → (tc) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537340400273195028.png?v=1" alt="spec" title="spec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809234922934282.png?v=1" alt="omniguard" title="omniguard" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → (tc) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1" alt="fingerofdeath" title="fingerofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → (tc) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434801938432010.png?v=1" alt="fingerofdeath" title="fingerofdeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → (tc) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1" alt="deathguard90" title="deathguard90" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → click Tumeken's light</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Melee </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /></strong><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478070401702821938.png?v=1" alt="meteorstrike" title="meteorstrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062906057949417.png?v=1" alt="adaptivestrike" title="adaptivestrike" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532854004678657.png?v=1" alt="berserk" title="berserk" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533810004262912.png?v=1" alt="surge" title="surge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (towards the Path of Tumeken) → click the Path of Tumeken → (tc) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532878969438210.png?v=1" alt="cane" title="cane" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → (tc) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879053062146.png?v=1" alt="pulverise" title="pulverise" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → (tc) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532879334080517.png?v=1" alt="overpower" title="overpower" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → (tc) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062908767211640.png?v=1" alt="chaosroar" title="chaosroar" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535532855191928842.png?v=1" alt="assault" title="assault" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → click Tumeken's light</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Add a basic attack </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1482849360462086244.png?v=1" alt="necrobasic" title="necrobasic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478062907295010906.png?v=1" alt="meleebasic" title="meleebasic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if they don't die in 1 GCD</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/r6hPuPjueK.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>At 2000% Enrage and higher, a climber will be chosen randomly by Tumeken, indicated by their skybox turning golden</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>As a last ditch effort, if the climber times out </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1" alt="instakill" title="instakill" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, a well timed </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1" alt="immort" title="immort" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will negate all of the damage, but Amascut will have much higher health than if she was phased normally</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="engulfing-shadow-shadow-tears"><ins><nowiki>Engulfing shadow &amp; Shadow tears</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ At the center of the arena is the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Engulfing shadow</nowiki></ins><nowiki>, which continuously increases Amascut's shield (black health) for the phase based on how much life it has</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Every time the climber kills a range/mage akh, </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Engulfing shadow tears</nowiki></ins><nowiki> will spawn across the arena, increasing in quantity for each akh killed and number of players present</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• These tears will heal the Engulfing shadow for 1000 health every tick, and for 15K health if not absorbed in time</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Engulfing shadow </nowiki><ins><nowiki>cannot be killed</nowiki></ins><nowiki>; the players on ground level must deal as much damage to it as possible to keep its health low</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is counterintuitive as the shadow will respawn with more health</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Engulfing shadow tears can be absorbed, preventing them from healing the larger Engulfing shadow, doing so will inflict a stacking debuff </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063107908702482.png?v=1" alt="combust" title="combust" kind="icon" /><nowiki> that deals </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will fully block the hit, but is best reserved for Clones</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="shadows-of-amascut-aka-clones"><ins><nowiki>Shadows of Amascut</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (a.k.a. Clones)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Once </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Tumeken's light</nowiki></ins><nowiki> is claimed by the climber, Amascut will summon a </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Shadow of Amascut</nowiki></ins><nowiki> for each player alive who isn't the climber</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If outside melee distance, they will dash at their target dealing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage, if in melee distance they will swipe at their target dealing </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If not all of them are dead at the same time, dead clones will deal huge damage to all players who aren't standing in the climber's </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Enlightened</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1" alt="interceptor" title="interceptor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> buff</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Go directly behind Amascut and stack up with the rest of the DPS pile who aren't climbing, pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for the initial dash attack from clones, pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> afterwards</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Kill them as quickly as possible with a strong AoE rotation (assumes you start as soon as she says </nowiki><code><nowiki>I WILL NOT BE SUBJUGATED BY A MORTAL!</nowiki></code><nowiki>, adjust timing based on clone spawn):</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Necromancy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></strong><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809121983336548.png?v=1" alt="invokedeath" title="invokedeath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (+ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1" alt="threadsoffate" title="threadsoffate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159435029592686642.png?v=1" alt="volleyofsouls" title="volleyofsouls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1138809243143766118.png?v=1" alt="deathguard90" title="deathguard90" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159433682403201044.png?v=1" alt="bloat" title="bloat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → improvise</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Magic </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /></strong><nowiki>: </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063122345361562.png?v=1" alt="runic_charge" title="runic_charge" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063117211668584.png?v=1" alt="gsonic" title="gsonic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/736298121704767538.png?v=1" alt="adrenrenewal" title="adrenrenewal" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (+ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/654618235097972737.png?v=1" alt="powerburstofvitality" title="powerburstofvitality" kind="icon" /><nowiki>) → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1478063106914779166.png?v=1" alt="gchain" title="gchain" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533809664262179.png?v=1" alt="omni" title="omni" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/958989794757730307.png?v=1" alt="tsunamiincite" title="tsunamiincite" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → improvise</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut becomes damageable once the clones are dead, unload as much damage as you can in ~20 seconds to remove her black HP and deal damage to her real HP to make Phase 7 easier</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Necromancy </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></strong><nowiki>: Aim to enter Phase 7 with at least 8 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139452791878856805.png?v=1" alt="necrosis" title="necrosis" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1139453152169558046.png?v=1" alt="residualsoul" title="residualsoul" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: The climber can deal damage to Amascut's shield directly with their </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Enlightened</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1" alt="interceptor" title="interceptor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> buff</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="player-bomb"><ins><nowiki>Player Bomb</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If the clones are not killed in time, Amascut will turn the players under attack by her clones into bombs, dealing ~12k typeless damage with defensive penetration to all players in a 7x7 area after a short time</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Finish off all clones before the players detonate, nulling all damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If the clones cannot be finished off in time, players must stand near the climber who has the </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Enlightened</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1" alt="interceptor" title="interceptor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> buff (appears as a golden aura around them) to null most of the damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Note: Any blast from outside the Enlightenment buff will still clip players who are inside of it</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="fight-mechanics-phase-7"><ins><nowiki>Fight Mechanics</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (Phase 7)</nowiki></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut pulls all players towards her and teleports them to a twisted version of the Throne Room, gaining </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Inner Shadow</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1403076345084379337.png?v=1" alt="shadowlink" title="shadowlink" kind="icon" /><nowiki> buff that massively reduces incoming damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ To finish the fight, players must withstand Amascut's onslaught and lower her health to 0 while preventing Tumeken from dying by intercepting her attacks on him</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="tumeken-strike"><ins><nowiki>Tumeken Strike</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ After 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> auto attacks in the first cycle and 3 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> auto attacks in subsequent cycles, Amascut will address one of the Bau of Tumeken by name and face Tumeken directly, charging an extremely powerful attack</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If intercepted incorrectly or not intercepted at all, the attack deals massive damage to Tumeken and heavy soft typeless damage to all players in the Throne Room</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Tumeken dies, the team </nowiki><ins><strong><nowiki>WIPES</nowiki></strong></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1104794644497309809.png?v=1" alt="instakill" title="instakill" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Players are assigned a quadrant based on their P2/4 roles, with Base Tank acting as fill should a player die</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Inside players are usually expected to go North, while Outside players go South</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut must be </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> towards the correct statue within ~3 GCDs, based on the following callouts:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585055297273896.png?v=1" alt="healinginstrength" title="healinginstrength" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Het</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><code><nowiki>Forgive me, Het.</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎(Southwest)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402579857648390224.png?v=1" alt="apmekensburden" title="apmekensburden" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Apmeken</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><code><nowiki>I am sorry, Apmeken.</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎(Northwest)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402583151322071091.png?v=1" alt="modesty" title="modesty" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Crondis</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><code><nowiki>Crondis... It should have never come to this.</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎(Southeast)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585081624924210.png?v=1" alt="carapace" title="carapace" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Scabaras</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - </nowiki><code><nowiki>Scabaras...</nowiki></code><nowiki> ‎(Northeast)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Once </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to correct statue, move out of the way or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to survive the massive followup typeless hit</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<pvme-video src="https://img.pvme.io/images/JKyDStksJE.mp4" controls="1" loop="1" muted="1" type="video/mp4" />
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><em><nowiki>Notes:</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>A singular bolt of light will shoot out from Tumeken to the correct statue, acting as a visual indicator for which statue is the correct one</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><em><nowiki>Statues in the room can be examined if in doubt about which statue is the correct one to stand in front of</nowiki></em></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="tumeken-strike-cont-on-fail"><ins><nowiki>Tumeken Strike</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (cont., on Fail)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
