<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If the players </nowiki><strong><nowiki>fail</nowiki></strong><nowiki> the Tumeken Strike mechanic, players will take massive typeless damage, and </nowiki><ins><nowiki>shadow tears</nowiki></ins><nowiki> will spawn across the room, while she resumes </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> auto attacks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Amascut's main target will also be targeted with </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Soul Crush</nowiki></ins><nowiki> after 3 auto attacks</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> pre-emptively to avoid taking huge typeless damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• If Tumeken dies, it doesn't matter as the team wipes instead</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Try to collect as many Shadow Tears as you can, as they will heal Amascut for 1000 LP/tick per orb</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-sequence"><nowiki>⬥ Huddle together or (Base Tank) </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> → </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258844635148.png?v=1" alt="res" title="res" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535614336207552523.png?v=1" alt="disrupt" title="disrupt" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1" alt="immort" title="immort" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (depending on enrage) to survive </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Soul Crush</nowiki></ins></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="tumeken-strike-cont-on-success"><ins><nowiki>Tumeken Strike</nowiki></ins><nowiki> (cont., on Success)</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If the players successfully handle the Tumeken Strike mechanic, Tumeken will take light damage and players will gain </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Light Within</nowiki></ins><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585098527965275.png?v=1" alt="interceptor" title="interceptor" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for 30s, lifting the damage cap from Inner Shadow </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1403076345084379337.png?v=1" alt="shadowlink" title="shadowlink" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ During this phase, Amascut will continuously perform her </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Empowered Eruption</nowiki></ins><nowiki> attack, as well as </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Devourer's Hieroglyphs</nowiki></ins><nowiki> and </nowiki><ins><nowiki>Devourer's Shockwaves</nowiki></ins></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Based on which of the Bau of Tumeken was called, Amascut will invoke a mechanic from the previous phases:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Apmeken</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: A random player receives Apmeken's Burden </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402579857648390224.png?v=1" alt="apmekensburden" title="apmekensburden" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Crondis</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Two Modest crocodile demons </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402583151322071091.png?v=1" alt="modesty" title="modesty" kind="icon" /><nowiki> spawn</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Het</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Amascut heals </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585055297273896.png?v=1" alt="healinginstrength" title="healinginstrength" kind="icon" /><nowiki> for 25% of all damage she does to players</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Scabaras</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Amascut becomes shielded </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1402585081624924210.png?v=1" alt="carapace" title="carapace" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and summons Explosive scarab akhs</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Try to deal as much burst damage as possible within the first few seconds of receiving the buff to finish off Amascut to skip all follow-up mechanics (except if Scabaras was called)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Depending on which of the Bau of Tumeken was called:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Apmeken</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Burden acts the same way as it does in Phase 2 and can be passed around between players, on lower enrages or if the boss can be bursted to 0 this can be ignored</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Het</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Can be safely ignored as the healing per hit from each attack is usually negligible</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Crondis</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Can be ignored if Amascut can be bursted down to 0 quickly, otherwise prioritise them to avoid taking too much off-style damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1159434663903899728.png?v=1" alt="deathskulls" title="deathskulls" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>will</nowiki></strong><nowiki> bounce onto the crocodiles, resulting in potentially fatal reflection damage</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Scabaras</nowiki></strong><nowiki>: Players must throw 3 Explosive scarab akhs at Amascut to remove her shield</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Empowered Eruption and floor mechanics will happen in tandem, players must focus on dodging the floor mechanics and praying correctly with defensives if bursting Amascut down to 0 within the first few seconds of receiving the buff isn't possible</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="base-tank-troubleshooting"><nowiki>Base Tank Troubleshooting</nowiki></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This section is reserved exclusively for troubleshooting Base Tank issues in higher enrages (1000%+), but may also be applicable for lower enrages.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Modest crocodile demons attack at the same time with different styles</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Prioritize praying </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> if getting off-styled on the same tick, as the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="ranged" title="ranged" kind="icon" /><nowiki> attack </nowiki><em><nowiki>can</nowiki></em><nowiki> miss; </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258786177064.png?v=1" alt="reflect" title="reflect" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158728953857.png?v=1" alt="devo" title="devo" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can negate a lot of damage from the crocodiles</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Base Tank from </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> spot becomes immobilised after tanking Soul Crush with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541258538582017.png?v=1" alt="immort" title="immort" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, leading to a follow up Devourer's Shockwaves hit</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 1 tile outside the first (outer) set of shockwaves to avoid defensives reset, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/864235458464186418.png?v=1" alt="cease" title="cease" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to avoid being moved back in</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1049378668197195808.png?v=1" alt="dive" title="dive" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 2+ tiles away from shockwaves can potentially make Amascut switch targets during Soul Crush</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Necessary if going for </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Dedicated Denial of Standing (here)</nowiki></strong><nowiki> Combat Achievement</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If Amascut starts P3 with Rapid Swipes, third one lines up right after Soul Crush, resulting in a high KO potential situation</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Solution:</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153883516958.png?v=1" alt="cadeturtling" title="cadeturtling" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/974504834394898522.png?v=1" alt="turtling3" title="turtling3" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or better will cover Rapid Swipes and scarabs exploding</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ Alternatively, the team can </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541259465392143.png?v=1" alt="voke" title="voke" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and split the big hit instead</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
